name: LLM Traffic Attribution
description: Per-caller LLM / GPU demand attribution from the LiteLLM gateway spend ledger
author: ai-stack / LiteLLM-Proxy integration

oneOf.description: Text query (optionally a time qualifier: today / last 24h / last week / since boot)

help.short: Who is using the GPU / LLMs — per-caller spend ledger from the LiteLLM gateway
help.long: Reads the LiteLLM gateway spend ledger (/spend/logs) and renders a per-caller breakdown: requests, tokens in/out, failures, average latency, models, last-seen. In permissive mode the presented API key string is the caller identity; friendly names map the known junk/empty keys to services. Append a time qualifier (today / last 24h / last week / since boot) to scope the window; default is last 1h.

examples.description: Per-caller breakdown over the last 7 days

examples.input: who is using the gpu today
